pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with highly jagged, star-like edges. Individual patches exhibit high-frequency serrations and diffuse pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial area of dark patches significantly exceeds that of the separating light zones.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Narrow, continuous light-colored pathways forming a complex topological lattice. Junction nodes predominantly consist of tri-directional intersections. Path thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but narrows toward the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a dense, short-haired silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background pixels.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized, near-circular white de-pigmentation spot is visible within a large patch on the upper anterior shoulder area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two dark-colored avian symbionts (oxpeckers) attached to the hide; one positioned on the posterior-lateral flank and another on the anterior-lateral shoulder/chest region.
